samplePolicy: one first-observed full-repository sample each, serial; two pilot repeat samples separate; no cold cache or global quality estimates

referenceSignalDefinition.RSA: RSA in rule ID or RSA/RSxxx/PSxxx in evidence.match
referenceSignalDefinition.ECDSA: ECDSA rule ID/evidence, ES algorithm rule IDs or ESxxx evidence
referenceSignalDefinition.ECDH: ECDH/X25519/X448 in rule ID or evidence.match
referenceSignalDefinition.X.509-object-or-literal: CERT_ rule IDs; multiple properties/containers can refer to the same object
referenceSignalDefinition.JWT-JOSE-rule-family: JWT category, JWT or JOSE rule ID; not proof of actual JWT
referenceSignalDefinition.hybrid-PQC: explicit ML-KEM plus X25519/P256/P384/NIST/SECP256R1 or ML-DSA plus Ed25519 composite in evidence.match

referenceSignalCaveats: Columns overlap, count findings rather than operations/objects, and miss masked evidence or unrecognized names. Zero is no grouped emitted signal, not absence. Algorithm correctness/use and true/false labels were not scored.
